name: Hitsssh
author: victor3232@users.noreply.github.com
description:
HITSSSH - all-in-one ringan: Node.js + Python + Cloudflare Tunnel dalam satu egg.
Runtime ada di dalam image, jadi area file server boleh dikosongkan / upload ulang script tanpa takut rusak.
Node.js 22 dan Python 3.12 sudah built-in. Versi lain (Node 18/20/24, Python 3.10/3.11/3.13/3.14) di-download otomatis saat start.
Cloudflare Tunnel tinggal isi CF_TOKEN dan set ENABLE_CF_TUNNEL=true.
Startup command auto-detect (package.json / main.py / app.py / bot.py) atau isi STARTUP_CMD manual.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================
#  HITSSSH Installer (runtime ada di image)
#  Install jadi cepat: hanya clone git (opsional).
#  Node/Python/cloudflared tidak diunduh ke folder server.
# ============================================================
set -o pipefail

echo "=========================================="
echo "              H I T S S S H               "
echo "=========================================="

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "[install] User upload mode: git clone dilewati."
elif [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
  ADDR="$GIT_ADDRESS"
  case "$ADDR" in
    *.git) ;;
    *) ADDR="${ADDR}.git" ;;
  esac

  if [ -n "${USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    ADDR="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo "$ADDR" | cut -d/ -f3-)"
  fi

  if [ -d /mnt/server/.git ]; then
    echo "[install] Repo sudah ada, menjalankan git pull..."
    git -C /mnt/server pull --ff-only || echo "[install] WARNING: git pull gagal, file lama dipakai."
  elif [ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "[install] Cloning repo..."
    if [ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]; then
      git clone --single-branch --branch "$BRANCH" "$ADDR" /mnt/server || exit 1
    else
      git clone "$ADDR" /mnt/server || exit 1
    fi
  else
    echo "[install] Folder server tidak kosong dan bukan repo git, clone dilewati."
  fi
else
  echo "[install] GIT_ADDRESS kosong: silakan upload file via File Manager."
fi

echo "[install] Selesai. Runtime Node.js/Python/cloudflared ada di image."
exit 0

variables.name: Startup Command
variables.description:
Perintah menjalankan aplikasi. Kosongkan untuk auto-detect:
- package.json + index.js -> node index.js
- package.json saja -> npm start
- main.py / app.py / bot.py -> python <file>
Contoh manual: node index.js | python main.py | npm start

variables.name: Python Version
variables.description: 3.12 sudah built-in di image. Pilihan lain: 3.10, 3.11, 3.13, 3.14 (otomatis di-download saat start pertama). Ganti versi cukup restart, tanpa reinstall.

variables.name: Node.js Version
variables.description: 22 sudah built-in di image. Pilihan lain: 18, 20, 24 (otomatis di-download saat start pertama). Ganti versi cukup restart, tanpa reinstall.

variables.name: Auto Install Dependencies
variables.description: Otomatis jalankan 'npm install' jika ada package.json dan 'pip install --user -r requirements.txt' jika ada requirements.txt. Di-cache, tidak mengulang tiap start.

variables.name: Aktifkan Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description: Set 'true' atau '1' untuk menyalakan Cloudflare Tunnel saat server start.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description: Token tunnel dari Cloudflare Zero Trust > Networks > Tunnels. Wajib jika tunnel diaktifkan.

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: URL repo untuk auto-clone saat install (opsional). Contoh: https://github.com/user/repo

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch yang di-clone. Kosongkan untuk branch default repo.

variables.name: Uploaded Files
variables.description: Set '1' jika file di-upload manual lewat File Manager (git clone dilewati).

variables.name: GIT ACCESS TOKEN
variables.description: Personal Access Token untuk repo private (opsional).
